items.summary: fix: keep foreground session updates responsive during cold maintenance (#161181) * fix(sessions): keep foreground updates responsive during cold maintenance Prepare the original existing database in the reclamation actor instead of opening the foreground executor first. Require canonical native validation, actual identity and lease acceptance before mutation, preserving incoming and outgoing revocable proof and current-authority checks. Keep caller refusal separate from source health, join native cleanup on source retirement, and retain exact cold versus warm lease accounting. Reuse the original concurrency tests and native admission fixture boundaries. Node proof covers the original 39-case pair, cold concurrency, validation reuse, archive/reclamation and Gateway siblings, with affected lease fixtures verified after accounting for the removed foreground actor. Two preparation lifetime cases also pass on Bun. Changed gates, all 27 test type graphs and independent review through P2 pass. The Linux-only managed SIGTERM case was not run locally. Schemas, retention, permissions and update behavior unchanged. Related: #160858 * fix(sessions): preserve cold preparation diagnostics Carry the logical reclamation context through native preparation and observe its real admission releases in the lifetime regression. Keep the foreground proof on the exact-replacement API using the established scoped fixture environment.

items.title: fix(test): serve normalized playback image requests
items.summary: fix(test): serve normalized playback image requests Chromium normalizes the escaped dot before requesting the fixture image. Match the normalized URI so native image error handling does not remove an image that the fixture itself rejected. Keep the original source URL assertion and require successful image decoding. Return the cached app-page promise directly, preserving the line-count ratchet without removing assertions. The focused playback check and three original UI shard replays passed, along with the full UI config on Linux.

items.title: ShinyHunters聲稱竊得FBI資料中，包含敏感的探員個資與醫療紀錄
items.summary: 駭客組織ShinyHunters聲稱駭入美國聯邦調查局（FBI）一事再有新發現。BBC於9月24日報導，他們檢視駭客提供的外洩資料樣本後，發現其中包含FBI探員的醫療檢查紀錄，涉及血液、尿液檢測結果及醫師註記，包括高膽固醇、血尿及食物過敏等資訊，部分資料並附有探員姓名、地址、電話、徽章號碼、職務及配偶資訊。

items.title: GitHub讓AI代理接手模糊測試，可依覆蓋率自動補測未觸及程式碼
items.summary: GitHub Security Lab開源Fuzzing Taskflow，可將大型語言模型代理與AFL++模糊測試工具串成自動化管線。開發者指定C/C++專案的GitHub儲存庫後，代理會找出適合測試的函式、分析建置方式、產生模糊測試程式並執行AFL++，再依程式覆蓋率修改測試程式或測試輸入，程式崩潰分析與漏洞報告也納入流程。GitHub提醒，漏洞判斷與修補內容仍須人工審查。

items.title: 新加坡電信商Simba遭駭，逾2.3萬名用戶個資外洩
items.summary: 新加坡電信業者Simba於9月25日公告發生資料外洩事件，影響23,549名註冊該公司服務的用戶，外洩資料包括用戶姓名、身分證號碼、出生日期、手機號碼及電子郵件地址，但信用卡與銀行帳戶資料並未受到影響，目前尚無跡象顯示相關資料已被惡意濫用。

items.title: 佛州要求法院限制OpenAI開發新模型，禁止向未成年人提供ChatGPT
items.summary: 美國佛羅里達州檢察長James Uthmeier周一（9/28）向法院聲請暫時禁制令，要求OpenAI開發新AI模型時，必須先取得獨立第三方對其安全防護措施的核准，並停止向佛州未成年人提供ChatGPT。法院尚未裁定此事。
